_meta.description: Known wallet addresses used across all Alliance DAO tooling. Catalog only includes COLLECTIVE / PUBLIC entities (treasuries, multi-sigs, protocol-owned wallets, named bribers). Individual member personal addresses are NOT included — members can paste their own address when needed.

schema.label: display name
schema.subtype: one of wallets subtypes from categories.json

terra1sffd4efk2jpdt894r04qwmtjqrrjfc52tm.label: aDAO Treasury
terra1sffd4efk2jpdt894r04qwmtjqrrjfc52tm.description: Main AllianceDAO treasury wallet. Holds the DAO's collective TLA positions, LP holdings, lock NFTs, and pending rewards.

terra1yqv0af22675wlcmgflxk4ve07vt8qlm999.label: aDAO Council Multi-Sig
terra1yqv0af22675wlcmgflxk4ve07vt8qlm999.description: Council operations wallet. Separate from the main treasury — used for council-level expenses and operations.

terra1ksk66lcvzwaanc47nvn3athj4yzcpay8z8.label: Lion DAO
terra1ksk66lcvzwaanc47nvn3athj4yzcpay8z8.description: Lion DAO bribe-funding wallet. 11 direct TLA bribes Sep-Dec 2024 (ROAR ×10 incl. a 500M ROAR add, ampLUNA ×1) into ROAR-ecosystem pools. Identification confirmed by DeFi_Patriot 2026-07-17 from the on-chain bribe pattern.

terra1k8ug6dkzntczfzn76wsh24tdjmx944yj6m.label: Phoenix Directive DAO
terra1k8ug6dkzntczfzn76wsh24tdjmx944yj6m.description: PD DAO core/treasury. TLA's largest briber: bribes via governance execution (proposal executes -> the DAO's own funds make add_bribe calls). Fixtures: prop 250 tx 402AE7B1...AAAA7 (34,763.53 LUNA net, epochs 193-196) and prop 247 tx 1CA243A3...AF1E (37,912.49 LUNA net, epochs 189-192). Also the destination of all gauge take-rate sweeps. Classifier v6.1 attributes these bribes here via the dao_attr rule.

terra1660g9mle5kfsq8c0p4k4hgr9ujdyr3m48c.label: PD proposal module
terra1660g9mle5kfsq8c0p4k4hgr9ujdyr3m48c.description: DAODAO-style proposal module executing PD governance proposals. NEVER attribute bribe totals to this address - the shared-module pattern means attribution belongs to the DAO named in the dao attribute (v6.1 dao_attr rule). Entry exists for tx-anatomy reference only.
terra1660g9mle5kfsq8c0p4k4hgr9ujdyr3m48c.notes: attribution goes to the dao_attr DAO core, not here

terra1t380w524ljhhn3rkw7wmuchkdhrcwl25dd.label: Solid Protocol (2024-25 bribes)
terra1t380w524ljhhn3rkw7wmuchkdhrcwl25dd.description: FCD-era Solid bribe wallet: direct CAPA bribes incl. 61,350 CAPA to the ampCAPA gauge 2025-01-02 (tx 5089C1C3...). Also the CAPA token contract feeshare withdraw address (deployer-tied). Confirmed by DeFi_Patriot 2026-07-18 from supplied chainscope txs.

terra1jlpfg4gnmflvjedx9cerrkjs72gmv57as0.label: Solid Protocol (current bribes)
terra1jlpfg4gnmflvjedx9cerrkjs72gmv57as0.description: Current Solid bribe wallet: three 1M-CAPA bribes across all three buckets 2026-06-21 (txs B2A2FF9F..., 0A62CAD0..., BB57A17C..., epochs 190-199). Linked to the 2024-25 wallet via the CAPA feeshare events in the same txs. Confirmed by DeFi_Patriot 2026-07-18.

terra1v399cx9drllm70wxfsgvfe694tdsd9x96p.description: One of the four per-bucket ve3 asset/tribute contracts: distribute_take_rate sweeps pool fees to the PD DAO, distribute_bribes recycles accumulated tokens into the incentive manager as bribes (the take-rate tribute class, classifier v6+).
